context: Security audit of sendViaTransport in android/app/src/main/java/com/scmessenger/android/transport/TransportManager.kt. Function extracted from recent changes (last 7 days).

claims.text: BLE fallback via GATT server connectedDevices.first() uses arbitrary peer when original peerId fails
No verification that the fallback peer is actually the intended recipient (peerId mismatch)
Returns false for INTERNET/TCP_MDNS without attempting SwarmBridge send
Correctly tries multiple BLE paths (L2CAP -> GATT client -> GATT server) before fallback
